# H2ODreamer Studio

> Web design studio in Malaysia helping small businesses and creators get online — conversion-focused landing pages, multi-page corporate websites, wedding e-invitations, and Shopify migration. Landing pages from RM 590; custom 5-page corporate sites from RM 2,500. Bilingual service (English / 中文).

H2ODreamer Studio (https://www.h2o-dreamer-studio.com) is a Malaysia-based web design studio. We build conversion-focused websites for small businesses, with WhatsApp integration, SEO, and Google Analytics included as standard. Typical delivery is 3–7 days for a single landing page and 1–2 weeks for a full 5-page site. Every project starts with a free 30-minute WhatsApp consultation. Contact: WhatsApp +60 16-689 7835.

## Services
- [Landing Page Design](https://www.h2o-dreamer-studio.com/landing-page): Single-page, conversion-focused landing pages from RM 590, delivered in 3–7 days, with WhatsApp and Google tracking built in.
- [Shopify Migration](https://www.h2o-dreamer-studio.com/shopify-migration): Migrating an existing online store onto Shopify.
- [Wedding E-Invitation — Basic](https://www.h2o-dreamer-studio.com/wedding-basic): Digital wedding invitation websites.
- [Wedding E-Invitation — Premium](https://www.h2o-dreamer-studio.com/wedding-premium): Premium, animated wedding invitation websites.

## Case studies — honest design breakdowns of example pages (concept demos, no fabricated metrics)
- [Case studies index (案例拆解)](https://www.h2o-dreamer-studio.com/case-studies/): All design case studies — landing pages, a Shopify store and wedding e-invitations — each explaining the target customer, the problem, and the reason behind every layout, colour and CTA choice.
- [CoolTech Aircon landing page — on-site service (上门服务 landing page 设计拆解)](https://www.h2o-dreamer-studio.com/case-studies/cooltech-aircon.html): How to design a single-page landing for an on-site service / aircon-repair business (single-page Plus, from RM 1,000): urgency-first hero, pricing up front (Basic RM 80/unit, Premium RM 200/unit with 30-day warranty), stacked local trust signals (licensed technicians, same-day service, no hidden fees, area-by-area job gallery, reviews), one-tap WhatsApp as the only CTA.
- [Wok & Flame — restaurant landing page (餐厅 landing page 设计拆解)](https://www.h2o-dreamer-studio.com/case-studies/wok-and-flame-fnb.html): How an F&B single-page Starter (from RM 590) works: an appetite-first hero, signature dishes shown as a showcase rather than a PDF menu, location/hours within reach, and a one-tap WhatsApp reservation; plus why restaurants often use a dark palette.
- [Glow Seoul — single-product skincare landing (单品护肤 landing page 设计拆解)](https://www.h2o-dreamer-studio.com/case-studies/glow-seoul-skincare.html): How a one-hero-product skincare landing (from RM 590) converts: total focus on one SKU, a promise aimed at the pain, ingredients as credibility, before/after and reviews to lower risk, and an FAQ that removes the last hesitation; soft palette for a sensitive-skin audience.
- [MUSE Apparel — Shopify fashion store (服装网店设计拆解)](https://www.h2o-dreamer-studio.com/case-studies/muse-apparel-shopify.html): Why a clothing brand selling online needs a Shopify store (from RM 10,000) not a landing page: an editorial brand hero, collections that fight choice paralysis, a consistent product grid, and free shipping + reviews + email capture as conversion levers; and when a business is ready to move from DM orders to a real store.
- [Elegant gold wedding e-invitation — premium (优雅金色高级电子喜帖设计拆解)](https://www.h2o-dreamer-studio.com/case-studies/wedding-premium-elegant.html): A premium e-invitation (from RM 1,500) designed backwards from the RSVP: an emotional mobile-first hero, a countdown that builds anticipation, a love-story timeline and gallery, and clear event details with an effortless RSVP.
- [Editorial gallery wedding e-invitation — premium (编辑感画廊高级电子喜帖设计拆解)](https://www.h2o-dreamer-studio.com/case-studies/wedding-premium-cinematic.html): A gallery-led premium e-invitation (from RM 1,500) for photo-rich couples: full-bleed photography leads, an editorial mixed-type layout, and the RSVP woven through the story rather than bolted on.
- [Minimal modern wedding e-invitation — basic (极简电子喜帖设计拆解)](https://www.h2o-dreamer-studio.com/case-studies/wedding-basic-minimal.html): A minimal Basic e-invitation (from RM 800) proving restraint looks expensive: subtract decoration not information, let type and white space carry the design, keep a clear path to the RSVP, and load fast on a phone.
- [Outdoor garden wedding e-invitation — basic (户外婚礼电子喜帖设计拆解)](https://www.h2o-dreamer-studio.com/case-studies/wedding-basic-outdoor.html): An outdoor/garden Basic e-invitation (from RM 800) where the design matches the venue: sage-green and amber earth tones, a romantic serif, mood-setting first impression, with essentials and RSVP kept clear.

## Blog — small-business marketing insights (Malaysia)
- [Which website does your business need? A by-industry guide (不同生意该做什么网站)](https://www.h2o-dreamer-studio.com/blog/which-website-for-your-business.html): Which website tier fits each type of Malaysian small business — F&B / café needs a single-page Starter (from RM 590), on-site service & repair (aircon, plumbing, phone) needs a single-page Plus (from RM 1,000), beauty / skincare / salon needs a 5-page corporate site (from RM 2,500), and fashion / retail needs a 5-page site or a Shopify online store (from RM 10,000) depending on whether it sells online; plus a 3-question test to place any business.
- [How much does a website really cost? 2026 Malaysia prices (一个网站到底要多少钱)](https://www.h2o-dreamer-studio.com/blog/website-cost-malaysia.html): The real 2026 Malaysia website price ranges — DIY (RM 50–150/mo) vs a done-for-you RM 590 landing page vs a RM 2,500 custom corporate site vs RM 10,000+ agency work; plus build time and maintenance, explained for small business owners.
- [WhatsApp isn't enough — the 6 hidden losses (WhatsApp 不是不够用，是不够让你赚钱)](https://www.h2o-dreamer-studio.com/blog/whatsapp-vs-website.html): The 6 hidden losses of running a small business on WhatsApp alone (slow replies, invisible on Google, no asset ownership, account-ban risk, untrackable ads) and what an owned website adds.
- [Social media isn't enough without your own website (FB、IG、小红书都有了，为什么生意还没起色)](https://www.h2o-dreamer-studio.com/blog/social-media-vs-website.html): 5 reasons FB / IG / Xiaohongshu / TikTok alone won't grow a Malaysian small business, and why an owned website is the storefront that converts and compounds.
